titles.romaji: Kemonokko Tsuushin: The Animation - Nekomusume Nia
titles.native: けものっ娘通信〜The Animation〜 猫娘ニア

description:
Nia, a cat demi-human, is summoned from another world by the main character Negishi. She is puzzled by the sudden change, but gradually becomes accustomed to this world. They decide to play a game to see who can cum first...

(Source: Fanza, translated)
